data.name: Controller
data.value: Makes the module a controller: each of its public procedures with an HTTP method annotation serves an endpoint.

data.name: Controller_Route
data.value: The route that prefixes the routes of the module's endpoints. When it is omitted, the route is the module's name less a Controller suffix.

data.name: KeptMachine
data.value: Runs each request to the controller on the machine kept for its key, the value of a route parameter. The machine is never reset: the key's requests share its state.

data.name: KeptMachine_Key
data.value: The route parameter whose value is the machine's key.

data.name: HttpGet
data.value: Serves the procedure for the HTTP GET method.

data.name: HttpGet_Route
data.value: The endpoint's route, under the controller's.

data.name: HttpPost
data.value: Serves the procedure for the HTTP POST method: the request's JSON body binds to one of its parameters.

data.name: HttpPost_Route
data.value: The endpoint's route, under the controller's.

data.name: FromBody
data.value: Names the parameter that the request's JSON body binds to.

data.name: FromBody_Parameter
data.value: The name of a parameter of the procedure.

data.name: NewMachine
data.value: Creates the machine of the request's key, then runs the procedure on it. Legal only in a controller with '@KeptMachine.

data.name: ControllerFactory
data.value: Names the function that creates the controller of each request. It runs on the class's default instance, and each of its parameters is given a service. Without this annotation, the function is Create.

data.name: ControllerFactory_Factory
data.value: The name of a public function of the class that returns the controller.

data.name: Service
data.value: Makes the class a service: a parameter declared as the service's name is given an object of the class, a New one or, when the class has a default instance, the one its Create function returns.

data.name: Service_Name
data.value: The service's name: the type a parameter declares to be given it, which the class is or implements. When it is omitted, the class's own name.

data.name: Service_Lifetime
data.value: Scoped (one object per request), Transient (one per parameter) or Singleton (one per machine). When it is omitted, Scoped.

data.name: Authorize
data.value: Lets only a signed-in user reach the controller or the action. A request that is not signed in is sent to sign in, and never reaches a machine.

data.name: Authorize_Policy
data.value: The name of a policy that Program.Run adds, which the user must meet. When it is omitted, any signed-in user.

data.name: AllowAnonymous
data.value: Lets any request reach the controller or the action, signed in or not, even when the controller has '@Authorize.
